articleTitle: Leveraging Semantic Analysis in Machine Learning for Addressing Unstructured Challenges in Education
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The present study explores the role of semantic analysis in machine learning for addressing unstructured challenges in education. Through a comparative analysis and literature review, various semantic analysis techniques and machine learning algorithms were investigated, examining their effectiveness and the factors influencing their success in educational contexts. The findings demonstrate that advanced semantic analysis techniques, such as word embeddings and deep learning-based approaches, significantly improve the performance of machine learning algorithms in processing unstructured data, leading to better natural language understanding and more accurate insights from educational data. Factors such as data quality, algorithmic complexity, and computational resources play a crucial role in determining the success of semantic analysis-based machine learning models in education. The study concludes with recommendations for further development and application of semantic analysis and machine learning in education.

articleTitle: The Growing Significance of Cyber Law Professionals in Higher Education: Effective Learning Strategies and Innovative Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article discusses the prospects and problems in cyber law education, concentrating on successful learning techniques and cutting-edge methods that can improve the caliber of teaching and student outcomes. The analysis uncovers various problems faced by higher education institutions, such as the lack of a standardized curriculum, a lack of faculty knowledge, and a lack of practical exposure for students, through a qualitative research approach that includes case studies and literature reviews. In order to improve cyber law education, the study underlines the value of using collaborative learning, simulations, real-world case studies, and technology integration. Innovations like gamification, virtual reality simulations, online and mixed learning models, and interdisciplinary approaches are also covered. The results imply that for the development of knowledgeable professionals capable of navigating the complicated legal environment of the digital era, cyber law education must continually be improved.

articleTitle: Intelligent Decision Support System for Assessing Works with Free Response based on Production Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Works with free response are usually used in training, as well as in engineering education. These works assessment faces a lot of challenges, especially in conditions of online learning. The use of criteria system underlies the formation of a score for work with free response. In the case of works like essays the assessment can be made without the participation of expert-tutor by means of automated essay scoring systems. In the other cases his engagement is required, and the assessment takes place usually manually with the use of a rubric. This procedure is very long and labour-intensive for tutors, particularly with the large number of works, which are to be assessed as quickly as possible. The challenge is further amplified by iterativeness of assessment procedure which is typical, for example, to term papers, productive and pre-diploma practice reports actively used in engineering education when students are as close as possible to real tasks implementation. Another question arises, because work assessment is carried out without consideration for work correction characteristics, that is why a formed score is inaccurate. A student work with free response assessment model based on production model that takes into account the efficiency of work correction made by student, and whose application allows to ease the formation of a score for work with free response, is proposed in the paper. The assessment model is implemented in an intelligent decision support system, which was used in assessing pre-diploma practice reports in Ufa State Aviation Technical University during online learning.

articleTitle: Influence of the Degree of Interactivity of Lecture Courses ON Improving the Quality of Learning Using the Electronic Educational Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: A comparison of the results of testing students before and after the use of interactive technologies in lecture courses. The conducted testing using the electronic educational environment (EEE) confirmed that the level of residual knowledge has become higher. It is shown that the assessment of students’ knowledge using traditional grades “excellent”, “good”, etc. is less informative than the average assessment by the value of the average percentage (%).

articleTitle: Topical Issues of the Use of Artificial Intelligence Technologies in Education and Law
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: According to the Constitution, the right of every person to education is guaranteed in the Russian Federation. The relevance of research. The authors of the article note that modern education in Russia and internationally is undergoing significant changes due to the active introduction of artificial intelligence into human life. Artificial intelligence (AI) is a way to make a computer—controlled robot or program capable of thinking as intelligently as a person. The basis for the creation of artificial intelligence are the following sciences and technologies: computer science, biology, psychology, linguistics.. The novelty of the research lies in determining the main directions of transformation of the educational process at the university in the conditions of cybersocialization of society. The purpose of the study is to identify the possibilities and problems of using artificial intelligence in the educational process and jurisprudence. The main tasks that need to be solved in this work: 1. To understand the reasons for the creation of artificial intelligence and the possibilities of its application in education and law at the present stage of development of society; 2. To explore possible areas of application of artificial intelligence technologies in the educational process; 3. To reveal the prospects of using artificial intelligence in teaching students and schoolchildren; 4. Evaluate the pros and cons of using artificial intelligence in education and law. The object of research in this article is artificial intelligence technologies. The subject of the research is the ways of improving and developing artificial intelligence in its application in education and law. The degree of scientific development of the topic of the publication. In the studies of A. A. Verbitsky, N. S. Ilyushenko, N. B. Strekalova, N. S. Kramarenko, A. Yu. Kvashina, S. D. Karakozova, A. Yu.Uvarova and A. Y.Akimova, on which this article is based, talk about the properties of digital education and the use of artificial intelligence technologies in it, about its possible advantages. Among them: accessibility, increasing the level of interactivity of training, the ability to choose the time, maximum audience coverage. The practical significance of the research lies in the possibility of applying its results in educational institutions of secondary education, secondary vocational education and higher education. Conclusions of the study: 1. Intellectual is a system that allows you to enhance a person’s mental activity by conducting a meaningful dialogue with him. 2. It is obvious that it is impossible and unnecessary to create a universal artificial intelligence. Highly specialized intellectual systems should be created, for example in education and law, which will not replace a person, but will facilitate his work. A person is not able to read a novel in one minute. The computer can do it. 3. The joint activity of man and machine, which analyzes information and presents it for selection, becomes relevant. 4. Today, artificial intelligence is a self-learning tool that enhances human activity in generating and making decisions. 5. In the current period, it will be necessary to resolve the issue of correlating the experience of introducing artificial intelligence into the most important social institutions of society, including education, and the existing proven practices of the traditional form of education.

articleTitle: Development of a Robot Arm with Neural Network Control
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article is devoted to the development of a robot arm with neural network control. This article presents the process of creating the electronic component of the device and design based on 3D printing technologies. The article describes the process of creating a prototype of a robot and its hardware, as well as software for controlling and training a neural network. We present the principles of operation of the neural network, its architecture, and training stages. We demonstrate the effectiveness of neural network control compared to traditional methods of robot arm control for some tasks. This article can be useful for both specialists in the field of robotics and in the field of education.

articleTitle: Proactive Production in Healthcare and in Advanced Training of Healthcare Workers as a New Approach Based on Lean Production
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article provides an original view on the prospects for the development of healthcare management using lean technologies. A new term is introduced -proactive production, as a definition for the management methodology based on lean production, which also includes complementary methods and tools of proactive management and a number of other methodologies. The essential role of lean and digital education in the training of effective personnel for healthcare is noted. An assumption is made about the expediency of forming a culture of lean production at the university, as well as the introduction of proactive production, as conditions for the effective professional development of healthcare workers in terms of the use of lean technologies and methods of proactive production.

articleTitle: An Educational Chatbot in a Blended Learning Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article discusses the educational potential of chatbots as an interactive learning tool. The didactic principles underlying the developed chatbot are presented. The chatbot interface for facilitating self-paced learning in a course on programming languages for facilitation self-paced learning in a blended learning environment is considered.

articleTitle: Architectural and Construction Training Based on the Productive Method of Creating Patentable Solutions
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article is devoted to the original author’s approach to invention in the field of architecture and construction. The concepts of “direct” and “reverse” paths in the process of branch invention are formulated. An original productive method for creating patentable solutions in architecture and construction as a result of the inventor’s “reverse” path is presented, as well as an example of its practical implementation. It is concluded that it is necessary to teach students of architectural and construction specialties the algorithms of the “direct” and “reverse” paths to ensure the technological sovereignty of the construction industry and the innovative development of industry enterprises

Author Keywords: architectural and construction training at the university

articleTitle: The Analysis of the Mathematical Training Content Using Cluster Analysis: Didactic and Technological Aspects
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article deals with the application of combining the methods of hard and fuzzy clustering to establish the frequency of interdisciplinary relationships. These relationships are defined by the main concepts of the mathematical analysis for students of mathematical specialties of a classical university. The training program provides for a deep mastering of mathematical content. Identifying the most in-demand concepts, properties, and relationships is the basis for optimizing the program and the content of the mathematical training to integrate the provisions of knowledge engineering, teaching theory, and educational practice.

articleTitle: The Online Course “The Organization of the Students Project Activities of Computer Studies in the Context of the Educational Technopark”: Ideas, Approaches and Development
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article deals with the issues of the organization of the project activities of Computer Studies on the basis of the educational technopark. The authors describe the experience of the development of the online course “The organization of the students project activities of Computer Studies in the context of the educational technopark” with the technical assistance of the technopark in Volgograd State Socio-Pedagogical University.

articleTitle: Computer-oriented Training of Pre-retirement Aged Specialists within the Framework of the National Project “Senior Generation”
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article discusses the issue of developing computer literacy among pre-retirement aged specialists. The problem of training and retraining citizens of pre-retirement age is noted. The scientific novelty lies in describing current approaches to educating older citizens, which differ significantly from those used for younger people, and in developing an additional professional retraining program called “Computer Operator” specifically designed for pre-retirement aged specialists.

articleTitle: Digital Competence as a Factor of Political Socialization of Youth
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article considers digital competence as a factor of political socialization of young people. The paper provides a theoretical analysis of the categorical apparatus of the study, formulates the author’s definitions of the terms “political socialization”, “political Internet-technologies”. The components of political socialization are determined. The structural and content composition of digital competence is revealed. Based on the selected criteria of political socialization, the main methods of recognizing political Internet-technologies are formulated. These recognition methods serve as a basis for young people to increase their digital competence in the political sphere. A model of a training course dedicated to improving the digital competence of young people is formulated.

articleTitle: Design of Specialized Interactive Teaching Aid: the Main Aspects
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Within the framework of the article the design of an interactive textbook is considered as a product of interaction design aimed at improving the efficiency of the learning process and increasing the comprehensibility of the material by students through the use of methods of motivation and individualization of the educational process.

articleTitle: An Innovative Method of Assessing Fine Motor Skills for Students Mastering the Profession
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The method is proposed that will be effective for determining the level of development of fine motor skills of future specialists in those professions in which hand coordination is important. The authors propose to introduce the Finger Fit standard when applying for jobs in professions related to fine motor skills. In addition, the proposed method can be used as part of professionally applied physical education.

articleTitle: Organization of Practical Work of Students in the Process of Integration of Higher Education and the Needs of Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The research is devoted to the need to apply a new approach to the organization of practical work of students in the conditions of integration of higher education and the needs of enterprises in order to implement the strategy of innovative development of the economy. Education should be oriented to the needs of real enterprises, taking into account the teaching of practical research techniques to students at the stage of obtaining theoretical knowledge. The article presents traditional and modern forms of integration of higher education institutions and enterprises for the training of highly qualified personnel and the development of the digital economy.

articleTitle: Technology Associated with the Formation of the Students‘ Mathematical Language at the Technical University
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Requirements to the educational process in universities is quite high. The volume of knowledge that is necessary for a person and society is growing rapidly. Sufficiently well-developed speech of a student is one of the decisive conditions for orientation in a huge flow of information. Activation of the educational process and the use of intensive teaching methods contribute to the high development of students’ speech. The paper deals with the initial studies for the development of students’ mathematical language.

articleTitle: Methodology for Studying a Learning Object Using Models of Various Typesaper
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The authors consider the issues of development of interdisciplinary universal scenarios of behavior among students of electrical engineering areas in the implementation of full-scale and computer educational experiment in order to form professional competencies. Based on the use of information technology, a practice-oriented scenario of the educational process is proposed, as close as possible to scientific activity. The possibilities of different types of computer models of the same object are considered. It is shown that the proposed methodology for the integrated study of one object using several types of models provides students with the necessary information and professional competencies by increasing the awareness of the perception of educational material.

articleTitle: Innovations in the “Boolean Functions” Section of the Discrete Mathematics Course
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This paper proposes innovations in teaching the course of discrete mathematics at universities, innovations refer to the “Boolean functions” section. A fast method for constructing the Zhegalkin polynomial for a given Boolean function is proposed. Also, for the use of Post’s theorem on the functional completeness is proposed a visual method for determining the presence of monotonicity of a Boolean function and a convenient criterion for determining whether given Boolean function is affine.

articleTitle: Studying Emotional Tone Transfer when Translating Literary Texts from English into Russian
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the problem of analysing translations made by students specializing in translation practices. There are proposed to use bidirectional convolution neural networks to find out emotions in original texts and in translations. Used models demonstrated high accuracy and were applied to the translations of two emotionally different texts.

articleTitle: Innovative Model of out of School Education
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Out-of-school education as an integral part of lifelong education of children is aimed at developing their talents and abilities and meeting their spiritual needs. The article proposes an innovative model of out-of-school education and the formation of the educational process using an online platform.

articleTitle: Non-linear Science University Course Building Variant
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The non-linearity science is a still hard-boning discipline often unrecognized or denied to exist. That is not wondering due to the literature flow with many ideas in many words but with no formulas at all. Due to the lack of efficient material, one needs to complexly revise the current core of formal models (and formal fact-knowledge) to build a maybe single possible current art state standard course core.

articleTitle: Self-organization of Scientific and Pedagogical Community as a Factor of Stability of the Education Informatization Processes
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article deals with the processes of digital transformation and informatization of regional education systems, which are driven by the processes of self-organization of the scientific and pedagogical community. A cluster approach for assessment of time periods of informatization in education has been highlighted. A hypothesis has been put forward about the intensive and sustainable development of clusters with the support of a set of measures aimed at the formation of new types of informal structures (scientific and pedagogical communities) in the environment of professional interaction. It has been emphasized that the self-organization of the scientific and pedagogical community is the result of building informal relationships between members of the local professional community with the purpose of solving a certain range of problems and performing functional tasks in managing the digital transformation of regional education systems. For the Khabarovsk Territory (Russia), for example, the initiators of such professional associations are the inter-regional public organization - “Academy of Informatization of Education” (AIE) and the Khabarovsk branch of the AIE, which unites scientists and specialists from universities, scientific institutions, educational institutions and education authorities. The Khabarovsk branch of the AIE has the potential to integrate the scientific and pedagogical communities based on the principles of self-organization.

Author Keywords: cluster approach for assessment of time periods in informatization of education
self-organization of the scientific and pedagogical community

articleTitle: Ethical Problems of Applying Artificial Intelligence: Medical Intelligent Systems and Autonomous Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: It is impossible to imagine modern life without intelligent systems that facilitate daily routine actions and save time. But how ethical does it become to use them in terms of improving the quality of their work? The paper analyzes the development of artificial intelligence methods, particularly in healthcare and unmanned transportation, and provides a discussion of the ethical aspects of the use of such systems.

articleTitle: The Specifics of the Organization of Independent Work of Students in the System of Secondary Vocational Education In Uzbekistan in the Context of the Transition to a Digital Economy
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The problem of self-education of students of professional colleges is one of the most important in Uzbekistan. With the improvement of the education system, the processes of education and upbringing, new aspects of this problem appear, associated with changing the content and setting new tasks. Social transformations caused by the transition to the information society actualize the problem of the formation of a new paradigm of education, which is characterized by a redistribution of emphasis from educational activities to self-educational ones. The use of electronic educational resources (computer educational and methodological complexes, textbooks, teaching aids, virtual laboratories, stands, posters, etc.) is today one of the conditions for increasing the effectiveness of training - the psychological, theoretical and practical readiness of students of professional colleges for independent work. Uzbekistan’s transition to a market economy dictates new requirements for a specialist, one of the main qualities of which is independence. The formation of this quality is determined, among other things, by the organization of independent work as a type of educational activity in educational institutions of secondary vocational education, which have their own specifics and features

Author Keywords: system of secondary vocational education in Uzbekistan

articleTitle: Network Interaction of the University and Enterprises in the Training of Staff in the Food Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The inconsistency in the implementation of the results of research and development obtained in the course of fundamental and applied research is acutely felt at the present time. This issue, as well as relevant specialized digital areas used in the training of specialists in the field of the food industry, nutrition, are considered in this scientific work based on a comparative analysis of the widely used network interaction of digital technologies.

articleTitle: Application of Modern Digital Technologies in Education
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article discusses various ways of using modern digital technologies in teaching students to improve the efficiency of the educational process. Examples of the use of these technologies in teaching students mathematics, training company employees are given.

articleTitle: Terminology Consistency of Computational Linguistics
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article is devoted to the analysis of the systematic nature of the terminology of computational linguistics. The purpose of the article is to establish system relations in the terminology of computational linguistics, identification of its relationships with other systems of special vocabulary, general scientific and interdisciplinary terms. The paper solves the problems of studying the sphere of functioning of the terms of computer linguistics, representation of its systemic connections in the form of a “core-periphery” model, analysis of the main types of interrelation of terms of computational linguistics with other systems of special vocabulary and common language. The study of terminological material is carried out on the basis of descriptive method and method of quantitative analysis. The results of the study showed that the terminology of computational linguistics functions as a system of special names in the scientific and applied field, focused on the use of computer tools, mathematical models and artificial intelligence in linguistics and related disciplines. System connections in the terminology of computational linguistics can be represented in the form of a core-periphery model.

articleTitle: Features of the Lifelong Learning Concept Implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article discusses the features in the knowledge economy. The inevitability of its implementation at the state level is emphasized, as a number of development trends encourage people to acquire new knowledge and skills in order to respond to social and economic changes. The formation of a system for lifelong learning will help the development of human resources: their self-realization, the healthy development of young people, the revival of local communities, the participation of older people in society, re-employment through retraining. The main features of education throughout life are highlighted. The methods of obtaining continuous education are summarized.

articleTitle: Some Elementary Labs for a Neural Networks and Data Science Introduction
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Neural networks and data science become more and more popular. Though regardless of the late appearance of new advanced libraries permitting neural network creation and training seemingly “in one code-line”, there remains a starting-point problem, when new-coming pupils cannot understand the subject before they create the working code, but they see an interface of black box laboratory works. The author having dealt with universal and advanced applied mathematics courses practiced a clear and concise neural networks introduction, reflecting state of the art before the 2012 year “Big Bang” when current top-used convolution, LSTM, and other Transformer-like networks become super-effective and super-popular. Instead, the presented course consists of approximately 5 of the very classical labs adopted to mainly standard Excel (without VBA) and in 1-2 cases to C#, and, more important we solve a problem of building a neural network or a model from the white sheet (including corresponding experiments) in a standard 4 academic hour time.

articleTitle: The Basic Principles of the Development of the Elearning Program in the Communities of the Schoolstudents
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article deals with the issues of the implementation of the e-learning programs in the communities of the schoolstudents. There is specified the concept of “online community”, there is considered the classification of the online communities. The authors describe the theoretical approaches to the development of the online course of Computer Studies in the context of the introduction of the Federal State Educational Standards and the digital transformation of education at the example of the online course “Training of schoolstudents to the Basic State Examination of Computer Studies”, implemented in Volgograd State Socio-Pedagogical University.

Author Keywords: the Basic State Examination of Computer Studies

articleTitle: Application of Methods of Statistical Processing of Data on the Heating of a Slab of Transformer Steel in the Minitab Software
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The paper considers the use of Minitab software for primary processing of data on the heating of a transformer steel slab in metallurgical production and the use of research results in the educational process for training specialists in the field of metallurgy and modeling of technological processes.

articleTitle: The Experience of Training the Students of the Pedagogical University to the Implementation of the Blended Learning at School
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article deals with the approaches of the definition of the blended learning. There are presented the components, defining the future teachers training to the implementation of the blended learning of Computer Science. The authors describe the experience of the training of the students in the pedagogical university to the implementation of the blended learning at school.

articleTitle: Research Project for the Shape Analysis of Arched Tent Roof Structures
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Tent construction is rapidly evolving engineering field with promising prospects. On the other hand, lack of competent specialists is one of the main problems for implementing the tent buildings into practice. The shape analysis of the arched tent roofs is proposed in form of a research project. It contributes to the professional training in the field of developing the tent building constructions. The problem for finding the equilibrium shape of the soft membrane of the tent structures is considered. Specialized software package for tent structure design, as well as, the general-purpose program for mathematical calculation are used. Static analysis of the tent structures subjected to external loads is considered. The analysis of the deformed surface is proposed.

articleTitle: Controller Tuning for an Object with Astatism of 2nd Order for Learning Purposes
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The present paper investigates the essentials of a controller tuning for an object characterized by 2nd order astatism. This object can serve as a steam boiler model aimed at providing the reference water head in the closed loop system with a proportional-differential controller. Several methods of optimal controller tuning are considered. The corresponding response curves as well as frequency responses of the system are presented to validate the tuning methods. The values of response time, overshooting, gain and phase margins satisfy the requirements applied to the systems under consideration. The resulting closed loop control system serves as a basis for developing a virtual reality (VR) learning environment for bachelor students major in power engineering and related fields. Employing an integrative learning approach into the training process allows students to acquire solid knowledge in control systems by using foreigh literature related to control systems domain.

articleTitle: A Social Resource of Education for the Elderly in a Digital Society
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Increasing the life expectancy of the population in a number of states of the planet actualizes the problem of studying the lifestyle of older people, their active involvement in society. One of the conditions for realizing the life potential of the elderly is education. Based on the analysis and generalization of the experience of Russia and foreign ountries, the authors of the article show that education as a social resource affects the employment of older generations. Another resource component of education is its ability to influence the quality of life of older people indirectly through their involvement in the system of social ties, through overcoming alienation from society, through increasing their adaptive capacity. The article analyzes the state policy of the Russian Federation in relation to elderly citizens, using the example of such a fundamental document as the “Strategy of Actions in the Interests of Senior Citizens until 2025”. As part of the implementation of this program, the “Older Generation” project involves the development of a number of models of the educational process and the improvement of professional qualifications for the older generation.

articleTitle: Project-based Learning: Formation of Students’ Digital Competencies
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article deals with the issue of digital competencies formation among higher education students. The study focuses on the project-based learning technology as one of the leading educational technologies used in the digital skills formation of a modern specialist. We draw on the fact that practice-oriented education and the formation of interdisciplinary skills are current trends in the preparation of future specialists. Several implemented projects are presented as the result of interdisciplinary project-research activities of students.

articleTitle: Formation of a Continuous Education System in the Digital Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article considers the concept of continuous education, emphasizes its priority as a socially and economically significant component of social development. The factors that determine the formation of the continuous education mechanism are identified: the widespread use of information and communication technologies, the merger of financial markets, the aging of the population, and the deregulation of markets. Continuing education performs professional, social and personal functions. The study of approaches to the formation of an education system throughout life made it possible to identify the main directions for the formation of a system of lifelong education and the effects received by the adult population.

articleTitle: Information Support System for the Concept of Educational and Methodological Material of the Module “Fundamentals of Russian Statehood”
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article analyzes the possible content of the information support system of the concept of educational and methodological material of the module “Fundamentals of Russian statehood”. It is concluded that it is necessary to create a single information portal, which will host video materials, information resources for scientific conferences and Olympiads of students.

Author Keywords: the concept of educational and methodological material

articleTitle: Development of a Software Tool for Searching Fake Educational Domain Names
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article discusses the latest research on the problem of fake activity associated with the creation of phishing sites and the sending of phishing emails. The relevance of this problem for educational portals is shown. As a solution to the problem, it is proposed to create and implement a software package for the analysis of fake activity. The article presents the structure of the program and databases of this package, describes the content of screen forms. The results of testing the software package on the dataset of domain names from the RU zone registry are presented. The introduction of the proposed software package for the analysis of fake activity in educational organizations will increase the degree of protection of Internet users from information threats from fake activity.

articleTitle: Using Videoconferencing in the Author’s System of a Teacher’s Activity
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article discusses one of the possible options for implementing e-learning using videoconferencing. A comparative analysis of some of these systems is presented. The key features of teaching students using videoconferencing are outlined, which must be taken into account in the course of developing a scenario for a lesson in the formation of the author’s system of a teacher’s activity.

Author Keywords: author’s system of a teacher’s activity

articleTitle: Professional Development of IT Industry Specialists at the Workplace: Trends, Focus and Prospects
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: To date the digital economy is a key mechanism for accelerating economic growth in the countries of the postindustrial stage of the development. However, at the global level, plans for its development are blocked by a serious shortage of specialists in the field of information and communication technologies, that is the main driving force of the digital economy. Therefore, the issue of overcoming the shortage of ICT specialists in order to ensure high rates of development of the digital economy and competitiveness in the global market is on the agenda today. The given study is devoted to the peculiarities of professional development of specialists in the field of information technology. The purpose of this study is to present an information model for organizing professional development for IT specialists at the workplace, built on the basis of the architecture of modern IT competencies. The work presents the results of the implementation of the preparatory, analytical, empirical stages of the study. Within the preparatory stage, a selection of relevant educational and end-to-end technologies, that can ensure effective interaction between the subjects of the educational process, was made. At the stage of analytics, an analysis of the structure of the IT-specialist market was carried out. At the third stage, an analysis of data on the needs of the IT industry and the labor market was conducted. The results of the study can be used as initial work-based data for organizing professional development for IT specialists.

articleTitle: Mining Standard Development in Information and Communication Technologies for Education
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article addresses the issues of applying the methodology of intelligent process analysis (mining process) to the development of standards in information and communication technologies within the digital ecosystem of engineering education.

articleTitle: Multiple Correlation Coefficient Versus Tolerances
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The use of mathematical software in teaching mathematical courses at a technical university dramatically changes the style and even the content of these courses. To a particularly large extent this applies to the course of mathematical statistics. Statistical software packages allow us to consider in detail (without increasing the number of teaching hours) of many complex advanced topics that were not included in the curriculum in the past or were only mentioned. One of such topic is the multiple regression models. In this article, we discuss the geometric meaning of the concepts associated with the multiple regression models such as multiple correlation coefficient, tolerances, partial and semipartial correlation coefficients. We consider examples of construction and analysis of multiple regression models in the STATISTICA software package that can be used in the classroom to illustrate the concepts discussed in the article.

articleTitle: Digitalization in Education and Learning Activities
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article deals with the content of the process of formation of noospheric-aesthetic images in younger schoolchildren. The possibilities of using digital technologies in their formation are analyzed, the features of the use of mind maps and quests in primary school are shown. The article is intended for primary school teachers, students, educators.

articleTitle: Intellectualization of the Data Processing in the Professional Development of Modern Specialists
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Continuous development of modern technologies and equipment models inevitably needs to improve the process of training highly qualified specialists who carry out their direct operation. As one of the most promising areas of improvement, the introduction of intelligent systems to support the continuous process of professional development of specialists (virtual assistants) with the ability to predict events in time, build an interactive spatio-temporal model of events is justified. It is shown that such systems should be based on the development and integrated use of modern methods of machine learning and analysis of a large amount of data to determine the most effective strategies for the professional development of a specialist, depending on the current personal competence, psycho-physiological portrait, as well as assessments of the expected conditions for the performance of functional tasks.

articleTitle: How can Moodle Quiz help teachers and researchers with complex questionnaires?
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In this paper different tools with extended features for organizing questionnaires are analysed. The existing Moodle tools do not allow to implement questionnaire questions with non-standard functionality: checking of entered text (in short answers), auto-completing data from user profile, s election of cards, post-processing of question execution, for example, saving information in a separate database. To overcome these disadvantages a methodology of creation plugins for new questions and their behaviour using Moodle Quiz is presented. Comparing to another solutions the advantage of the methodology proposed is that it is possible to create a combination of quizzes and surveys (questionnaires). We present the development of a conference support system as another complex application. Also, there is an example of a mixed questionnaire test-like system for collection of a feedback from users about a connected test. In such applications it is necessary not only to collect data, but also to make sure that a person understands how to input it correctly. A system of 8 developed plugins is described.

articleTitle: On the Issue of Teaching Data Analysis and Machine Learning to Students of Medical Specialties
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Current trends in the transition to the use of new information technologies in all spheres of society make the issue of digital transformation of medicine relevant and significant as the most important means of solving the problem of digital transformation of the economy. Building digital medicine is one of the main strategic directions of the state policy of the Russian Federation. There is a need to teach students of a medical institute disciplines related to modern information technologies, namely data analysis technologies and machine learning as one of the relevant devices for processing and analyzing large volumes of medical information in order to increase the availability of medical care for patients and create auxiliary tools that simplify the work of doctors. The article presents the discipline (module) “Data Analysis and Machine Learning in the Medical Sphere”, which can be useful for medical students, as well as medical residents and graduate students. The skills acquired during its study will make it possible to implement applied projects in the field of medicine and natural sciences. Note that this discipline (module) is universal and is aimed at training various professional groups. Among the students there can be both those studying in the direction of “General Medicine”, and students of the directions “Pediatrics”, “Dentistry” and “Pharmacy”, due to the availability of the proposed material, and the importance of obtaining theoretical knowledge and practical experience in solving problems in the field of data analysis in digital medicine.

articleTitle: Improving the Efficiency of Students’ Education through the Study of Regulators Used in Lane Tracking Automatic Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The work discusses the issue of an automatic lane tracking system. Students studied controllers during the system modeling process. The system consists of multiple electronic components, including photodetectors, logic elements, and light emitters. An analysis of the shortcomings of the existing system was carried out. Mathematical models of the tracking system were developed and created using the Matlab Simulink software package. Studies were conducted on the system’s performance with various controllers. The logarithmic amplitude frequency response of the existing closed-loop and open-loop lane tracking systems was compared. Students analyzed the logarithmic characteristics to enhance their knowledge. Transition characteristics of the lane tracking were demonstrated. A detailed description was provided to determine which system performs better in tracking the object.

articleTitle: Olympiad Programming Movement Features in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Olympiad programming also called algorithmic programming or sports programming involves writing computer code in an arbitrary programming language (C++, Python, Java, C# and so on) that is the solution to a given problem. The solution must be efficient (i.e. fast) in time and efficient (i.e. small) in memory consumption during execution. Many schoolchildren participating in school Olympiads in Informatics continue to improve their skills and participate in student competitions. This article is devoted to features and practices of such Olympiads.

articleTitle: Combined Aporoach to Higher Education in the University: Relevance, Opportunities and Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article focuses on the combined approach to higher education. The specific features of legal education are considered, the combined approach, the possibility of its application and prospects are investigated.

articleTitle: New Approaches in The Formation of Modern Digital Competencies in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The digital world and related technologies are developing at an accelerated pace. It is extremely difficult for specialists, university teachers, especially students to keep up with the latest innovations. An important feature of the last decades has been the use of ready-made technological solutions in the construction of new tools and new information systems. This is due to the active use of various frameworks, information technologies platforms and various digital services. This leads to the need for everyone to constantly improve their skills, lifelong learning becomes an urgent necessity. In addition, it is necessary to change the formats of training sessions, the use of new technologies and approaches in education. The paper also draws attention to the risks associated with the introduction of new digital solutions and services.

articleTitle: Automatization of Tests to Assess Knowledge of Foreign Students in Teaching Mathematics
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the problem of automatizing knowledge assessment. There is given the analysis of existing learning management systems and questionnaire tools to support educational process. On the example of joint bachelor program in the field of Metallurgy is presented the scheme to knowledge in Mathematics of students studying in English.

articleTitle: Study of Pre-Stressed Tent Building Constructions by using Digital Design Tools
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Tent building constructions are far superior to the ordinary structural elements, such as reinforced concrete slabs and steel plates. Structural behavior of the tent buildings is complex thus obligating the prospective specialist to deep understand the key concepts. The soft membrane, being a constituent part of the tent constructions, must be pre-stressed. Different pre-stress strategies for arched, high-point and mixed tent roofs are considered using digital design tools of the specialized software package for non-linear structural analysis EASY.2020. The design tools allow to numerically find the initial shape of the soft membrane, to simulate the pre-stress and to visualize the results. Tensioning the membrane along the supporting arches and in the direction which is perpendicular to the arches, lifting the top rings and the combined methods are simulated and analyzed. Application of digital tools to simple models of tent roof constructions facilitates professional skill building in the field of research and development of pre-stressed tent constructions.

articleTitle: Aspects of Teaching IT Cources for Metallurgy-Bachelor Students under the Joint Program between Russian and Chinese Universities
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In the paper the experience of teaching the ”Python Programming” discipline in the joint educational program in metallurgy between Lipetsk State Technical University (LSTU) and Liaoning University of Science and Technology (USTL) for USTL students is presented. The structure of the discipline program and features of its implementation in online and offline formats are provided. The structure of the program takes into account the possibilities of future usage of the obtained competences in professional activity. The specific feature of online classes is using the learning management system (LMS) Moodle. The feature of the offline educational process is the semester training course implementation in one month.

articleTitle: Testing and Evaluation of a Model for Optimizing the Process of Information Interaction of Users with Distributed Digital Learning Resources Based on the Chatbot Software
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The main features of information interaction in the information and educational environment are considered. The transformation of the traditional structure of interaction between the participants of the teaching and learning process and digital learning resources is presented. It is proposed to include an additional component of the chabot in this scheme. To illustrate the proposed model the DFD methodology is used. The chatbot presented in this study was beta tested in a web development technologies course. The results of testing the functionality within the framework of the proposed model are shown. Assessment results for the experimental and control groups are presented.

articleTitle: Some Innovations in Section “Combinatorics” of Discrete Mathematics Course
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose some innovations in the presentation of some issues of the discrete mathematics course. We propose a proof of the inclusion-exclusion formula using the algebraic essence of this formula. For this, the concept of a “foliated” set is introduced, which generalizes the concept of a multiset. In addition, for some basic combinatorial numbers, proofs of formulas for their calculation by natural combinatorial reasoning are proposed.

articleTitle: On the Problem of a Physics Teacher Readiness for Professional and Pedagogical Activities in the Conditions of Higher Education Digitalization
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The current state of the readiness of a physics teacher for professional and pedagogical activities in the context of the rapid growth of information technologies and the development of electronic information opportunities among university students are analyzed in the article. A review of scientific and methodological literature is being carried out on the concept of “readiness for professional and pedagogical activity” the concept of readiness of professional and pedagogical activity is being specified in relation to a physics teacher who implements educational programs of specialization in universities based on the use of modern electronic information technologies. The article concludes that modern digitalization, against the background of huge opportunities for creativity and the manifestation of pedagogical skill in creating electronic educational resources in physics, creates colossal problems that can be solved if the physics teacher is ready to work in digital mode. An example of methodological developments in physics created by physics teachers for training students based on the use of modern information technologies is also given.

Author Keywords: training in physics based on digital technologies

articleTitle: Improvement of Additional Professional Education System in the Construction Field on the Basis of the Concept of Multi-Track Educational Programs
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the professional landscape in the construction industry, a concept has been proposed that makes it possible to implement construction training in the system of additional professional education based on multitrack educational programs. The implementation of the proposed approach makes it possible to solve the problems of personalization of education, the formation of flexible study schedules and a flexible system for training civil engineers in general, as well as the organization of individual educational routes. Curricula and educational and methodological support of the educational process have been developed, which allow maintaining the qualifications of employees at the appropriate technological level, improving it if necessary, and also ensuring the possibility of changing it throughout the entire career path of the employee. The article presents the schemes for the passage of professional retraining by the listener, implemented within the framework of the relevant tracks, as well as the content of the training programs included in them.

articleTitle: Problems of Teaching Information Technologies to Students From India at a Russian University
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Based on a survey conducted among students from India, a phenomenon called the “digital divide” was discovered. In this connection, the authors of the article, in order to overcome it, substantiate the need to organize differentiated training for students, future doctors, the course “Informatics in English”, and also propose to change the living conditions of foreign students in the hostel.

articleTitle: Transformation of the Education System in the Context of Digitalization
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article examines the transformation of the education system under the conditions of digitalization. Analyzes the international and Russian experience of implementing digital technologies in educational processes. The positive aspects of this process, as well as the difficulties with which this process is accompanied. Possible negative trends associated with the digitalization of education are also analyzed.

articleTitle: Using a Taxonomic Approach When Teaching Foreign Languages
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: During learning English as a foreign language a number of sections which include phonetics, grammar, etc. causes difficulties. The study presents the using taxonomic structures during the process of studying complex topics in English by non-native speakers. The proposed approach to solving the problem makes it possible to structure, formalize, visualize and thereby facilitate the assimilation of complex topics by students. Particular attention in the article is paid to the issue of visualization of the taxonomic structures of English educational material through modern software tools; their using during the process of learning foreign languages contributes to its improvement and the quality of acquiring new knowledge.

articleTitle: The Path Orthodoxy at the Education Leads to the Person Spiritual Recovery
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article deals with the issue of proper education of modern youth. It describes how technology affects these processes in educational institutions. It is explained that Orthodoxy is the only true way in the development and formation of the personality of the modern generation. The definition of the concept of “spiritual health” is also given, its criteria are considered and how the application of the Orthodox component in the educational process is implemented is touched upon.

articleTitle: Modeling the Development of Russian Universities
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The main problems of the development of the higher education system in the Russian Federation, characteristic of both the federal system as a whole and its regional components, are considered. The directions of solving these difficulties in order to improve and effectively develop, ensure the state order for education are proposed. This includes the development of communication systems, distance learning, issues of expanding the training of foreign students. The possibilities of modeling the processes of functioning and development of educational institutions based on the use of the methodology of scenario research of complex systems are considered. A basic simulation model of an educational institution based on the method of constructing operator graphs is proposed.

Author Keywords: problems of the higher education system

articleTitle: Online Educational Community as a Platform for Online Teaching of Python Programming Language to Schoolchildren
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The issues of teaching schoolchildren of online communities programming in the Python environment using learning management systems (LMS) and Internet services: Google Docs and Google Colabratory are considered.

Author Keywords: unified state exam in computer science and ICT

articleTitle: Statistical Approach in Relation to the Study of Compatibility
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The extraction of collocations is one of the urgent tasks in the processing natural language, the results of which are important and in demand in various fields of applied linguistics. Our study compares three statistical measures carried out on a subset of The English Trends Corpus. The corpus has a huge methodological potential, so its use in foreign language lessons will allow students to cope with the solution of many educational and scientific problems, significantly expand their understanding of language as a changing phenomenon. Automatically extracted verb collocations in which the semantically main component was the search query word take were considered. During experiments studied the differences between statistical metrics, and also an attempt was made to find the most effective of them. The Pearson rank correlation coefficient between the measures was calculated. The results obtained show that some measures show similarity and relative interchangeability.

articleTitle: Augmented Reality and Interactive Technologies as a Means of Rehabilitation Disabled Children
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Study and analysis of the elements of virtual reality in modern information and educational space are considered in the article. The article discusses the principles of integration of virtual environment with the information space. The authors describe the structure of interactive technologies for obtaining information, structuring and compiling databases, coordinating, interacting and managing design forms and objects.

Author Keywords: modular transformer table with a “smart” hand

articleTitle: Using the Capabilities of an Electronic Textbook in the Educational Process of Bachelors
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article gives the author’s definition of an electronic textbook; From the standpoint of the algorithmic approach, its structure is described, including stages and modules. On the example of author’s electronic textbooks, the possibilities of their use in the educational process of bachelors are revealed. The criteria for the assimilation of knowledge and universal educational actions (motivational, cognitive, practical and operational, contact) are determined; The characteristics of the levels of their formation are given. With the help of Fisher’s angular transformation, the effectiveness of the use of electronic textbooks in the educational process of higher education is proved.

articleTitle: Psychological Support of Handball Players Preparation for Competitions with Information Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article deals with the psychological and pedagogical aspect of preparing handball players for competitions. It describes how a coach, taking into account the psychological characteristics of a player, can most effectively build a training process, and thereby improve the results of the team. The features of psychoforming training are considered. Special attention is paid to the information approach, which is the most important component in the psychological preparation of athletes.

articleTitle: Neural Networks Application for the Classification Problem Solving with Domain Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The paper investigates an approach based on neural networks to solve the classification problem with domain constraints. The practical application of the developed methods in the subject area of oil production for solving the problem of optimizing the control of pumping equipment of oil wells is considered. The solution of the problem is carried out in real time based on the classification of the flow modes of the oil-water-gas flow according to the indications of a multiphase flow meter installed on an oil well.

articleTitle: Digitalization in the Field of Polylingual Education
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Globalization, interlingual communication, the development of economic and intercultural relations between countries leads to an increase of the importance of foreign languages knowledge. In modern society knowledge of foreign languages is a kind of indicator of a person’s education, which can greatly affect the rapid and successful advancement of a person in various fields of activity. The development of interstate and intercultural relations expands the areas of interaction between representatives of different countries and cultures. That is why the problem of polylinguism is becoming increasingly important. One of the goals facing the education system is the development of a polycultural personality who speaks several languages and is able to carry out communicative and activity operations in three or more languages in different situations. Polylingual education today is one of the main directions in the education system. Polylingual training of students is integrated with the process of digitalization of education. These trends require the introduction of innovative digital resources and digital tools into the educational process, which would ensure the assimilation of language knowledge by students and contribute to the development of basic communicative competencies.

articleTitle: Formation of Probabilistic Thinking of Students Through Computer Simulation on the Example of Studying Distributions with Heavy Tails
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article considers the possibilities of integrating computer modeling into the process of the formation of probabilistic thinking in teaching mathematics students. We give an example of studying the features of heavy-tailed distributions in comparison with the properties of a normal distribution.

articleTitle: Language and Cultural Education Adaptation in the Multilingual Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article deals with the peculiarities of education adaptation procedure in the process of multilingual environment on the example of African education. The research work is aimed at comparing and contrasting two education systems with English and French as the language basis. According to the research work African countries face the challenge in educational processes for all levels: primary, secondary, high level education due to having chosen foreign languages as the ground. The variety of local ethnic majorities and minorities languages is the reason to have a foreign language (French and English) or even two as the official language of the country and of education system within the countries of Africa. English basis education starts with the step of secondary level and is taught as the foreign language. Primary education in African countries with English as the official language is based on one of local languages majorities, sometimes alien to children belonging to ethnic minorities groups. High education is available only in English. French basis education starts with the primary step and is based on oral practice approach which has proved to be successful. Reading and writing are added during secondary education procedure. Education with French as the language basis includes serious testing system proving the level of knowledge and psychological aspects not only among students but teachers as well who have to confirm the level of knowledge twice a semester. All African countries face the problem of adults’ illiteracy which is solved by means of special group courses education based on local languages ground.

articleTitle: Implementing Cloud Computing in Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: With the development of the Internet of Things, the number of devices connected to the Internet has increased exponentially, leading to a huge increase in the amount of data to be processed in the cloud, with a significant increase in traffic at the expense of service quality. This, along with the low latency and mobility requirements of many web applications, has led to the emergence of computing options that are closer to network devices. Cloud computing has emerged as a new paradigm to address these issues, extending traditional cloud computing architecture to the boundaries of the network. Despite the rapid development of cloud computing, there are challenges associated with its implementation in real-world scenarios such as smart cities, where the heterogeneity and mobility of devices, as well as the required scalability and interoperability need to be considered. Accordingly, this paper presents a procedure to guide the implementation of this technology in smart cities. As a partial test, the proposed procedure is applied to the use case of rubbish collection

articleTitle: Highly Successful Models In The Applied Mathematics Teaching
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article is devoted to an obvious terra-incognita in contemporary education and Atlántida on the natural science planet – the applied mathematics subject. This subject normally should be the central one after the practice-orientation principles (likely wrong enough) were announced as the main educational keystone, but it isn’t. The strange negative success of this discipline can be explained partially by its’ specific (long chain methods) and partially by not understanding this circumstance. In the article, we continue the chain of publications explaining how one should build an applied mathematics course based on malty-parametrical problems [2]. Here we talk about applied mathematics course possibilities and content constraints.

articleTitle: The Role of the Concept in the Formation of Cognitive Representations of Students (on the Example of the Concept “Appearance” in the Russian, English and German Languages)
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The appearance of a person as a special object of study in the humanities (philosophy, cultural studies, psychology, kinesics, ethnology, law, and aesthetics) appears as a multidimensional phenomenon connected through culture with the surrounding world, with social relations, aesthetic perception. The synthesis of these components is the concept of “Appearance”. The article is devoted to the study of “Appearance” concept objectivation through highlighting the expressive features of a person, namely, his face and hair in the Russian, English and German languages and its role in the formation of cognitive representations of students. As a rule, when identifying a particular person, great attention is paid to some certain, personal features of appearance. Eyes, hair, lips, complexion usually attract people’s attention most of all. The appearance of a person is valued by others and, as a result, it is endowed with the ability to transmit information about the inner world of a person, to identify individual qualities and properties inherent only in this person. It is from this point of view that appearance is informative and communicative. The article also considers the connection between such aspects of Linguistics as a concept and the language, as well as the way the features of the concept under study are being realized in the Russian, English and German languages. The work provides a large number of examples taken from the authentic works of literature that can be used in the teaching both Russian and foreign students.

articleTitle: Technology-Enhanced Education: Digital Media in Training Future Language Teachers/Translators/Interpreters
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The current study aims at identifying students’ attitudes towards digital media presence in the classroom, their usability and likely output in educational practices. A future language worker should know how to deal with all these new epoch communication aspects and should be trained to recognize and arrange the much needed communicative mechanisms and instruments to undergird and sustain fruitful educational collaboration. Teaching-learning agenda for the students that are seeking to become teachers/translators/interpreters should be based on some non-linear discourse-oriented model. The paper further analyzes the options that can be proposed to train proper communication skills (including mediation competence) through practicing media-centered activities. A group of respondents was introduced to and involved in a set of assignments and activities based on media platforms content with built-in links to provide a vibrant speech practice discussion or a challenging self-study assignment to improve students’ communication and mediation skills. Results indicate that the web-based tasks focus on some pressing topics and can fruitfully recontextualize the academic planning either for specific linguistic disciplines (Media Discourse, Language-Culture Study) or just for speech training at language classes. The study highlights the opportunities for both teachers and students to realize their language and mediation potential.

articleTitle: Unstable Teams: Management of Remote User Interface Evaluation in Adaptive Software Development
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The paper considers problems of management of remote unstable teams in agile software development. The purpose is to discuss the modified model of Adaptive Software Development (ASD) complemented with interface evaluation procedures in the conditions of development by unstable development teams with remote participation and the possibilities of experimental implementation of the model. We propose to add each iteration of the ASD model with autonomous tasks for remote evaluation of the user interface, which are carried out by remotely involved performers. Methods may include behavioral and psychophysiological metrics based on eye-tracking and emotion detection in remote user experience. We justify the effectiveness of experimental verification of the model for remote teams of students undergoing software development training using modified ASD methodology. As a result, the additional problem of ensuring sufficient selection of qualified users for evaluating professional projects interface with behavioral and psychophysiological methods can be solved: the possible way is to involve students undergoing software development training and performing remote autonomous tasks within unstable professional teams.
